reason: Verification failed with multiple major gaps versus the specification (missing Household entity and interactions, non-functional Location behaviors, incomplete PolicyMaker messaging, missing key metrics, and a small but important epidemic logic bug). With one iteration remaining (15/15), there is still clear potential for significant improvement by implementing a focused set of changes that directly address the spec gaps and naming mismatches. The codebase is syntactically sound and stable, so a targeted refactor can likely bring it to an acceptable level in the next iteration.

specific_areas: Add Household entity and household_norms/share_masks interactions: Implement Household dataclass (id, size, norm_strength, mask_stock); assign each Person to a household; implement discuss_norms (update mask_attitude/compliance_propensity) and share_masks (allocate mask_stock to members with adoption_intent before daily decisions).

Refactor Location to be active in the daily flow: Implement admit_agents (capacity), enforce_policy (per-location enforcement_probability and fine_amount; deny vs fine), broadcast_norms (use recorded_compliance to update perceived norms next day), and record_compliance (per-visit logs). Integrate these into an explicit visit flow driven by Person.daily_schedule.

Extend Person attributes and behaviors to match spec: Add age, health_risk_level, social_influence_susceptibility, economic_constraint, adoption_intent, compliance_propensity, info_sources, daily_schedule, perceived_local_cases; implement visit_location behavior and use these attributes in decide_mask_use and observation updates.

Implement PolicyAuthority messaging: Add publish_case_counts and adjust_messaging; support external perceived_cases_series blending with simulated prevalence weighted by trust_in_authorities and messaging_intensity; update Person.perceived_local_cases and risk_perception accordingly.

Add missing metrics and naming aliases: sustained_compliance_duration (track per-agent streaks), switching_rate (daily fraction switching), peer_exposure_index (average masked-share exposure across ego networks), final_adoption_rate (last day), and aliases compliance_by_location and policy_effect_size (alongside existing outputs).
Fix epidemic source-control timing: Compute infectious source-control using current-day wearing (wearing_now restricted to infectives).
Parameterize homophily_strength: Replace hard-coded rewiring probability with homophily_strength parameter.
Time step clarity: Validate that only daily steps are supported (time_step_days=1); warn or document rather than partially supporting non-unit steps.

task_understanding.adjustments: Re-align strictly to the specification entities and interactions: Household and household_norms, Location-level enforcement and norms broadcasting, and PolicyAuthority-driven information_campaign. Ensure metric names match the spec.

data_analysis.adjustments: Support optional external perceived_cases_series; define blending weight and trust-based modulation. Document assumptions when external series is absent.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan a minimal but complete integration path: 1) add Household and Person attributes, 2) refactor Location visit pipeline, 3) integrate PolicyAuthority messaging, 4) compute missing metrics and aliases, 5) fix epidemic timing and homophily parameter. Define acceptance criteria per item.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement new classes/methods with clear docstrings and type hints; maintain backward compatibility of outputs by adding aliases (e.g., compliance_by_location, policy_effect_size). Keep changes cohesive and localized to simulation.py where feasible.

code_verification.adjustments: Add sanity checks: non-negative counts, capacities respected, enforcement events recorded, per-location compliance logs non-empty when visits occur, streak tracking consistent. Include a small deterministic test run to validate key metrics exist and have expected shapes.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Introduce an explicit daily visit loop: generate or use provided Person.daily_schedule; process admissions/enforcement at Location level; update per-visit compliance and observations. Ensure runtime remains acceptable for default N.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute and return sustained_compliance_duration, switching_rate, peer_exposure_index, final_adoption_rate. Provide aliases compliance_by_location and policy_effect_size. Verify that policy effect is computable even if DiD variant remains the internal calculation.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Map each spec requirement to implemented code sections in comments or README notes; document any limitations and default assumptions (e.g., daily time step). Summarize the impact of changes on adoption and epidemic metrics.
